# NYC Motor Vehicle Collisions — Crashes

Source: NYC Open Data, dataset `h9gi-nx95` ("Motor Vehicle Collisions - Crashes"), published by the NYPD. Snapshot downloaded 2026-10-03.

Official description (paraphrased): each row is one police-reported motor vehicle collision in New York City. A police report (MV-104AN) is required when someone is injured or killed, or when there is at least $1,000 of damage. The data is preliminary and subject to change.

File: `crashes.parquet` (one row per crash)

| Column | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| collision_id | BIGINT | Unique identifier of the crash |
| crash_date | DATE | Date of the crash |
| crash_time | TIME | Time of the crash |
| borough | VARCHAR | Borough where the crash occurred |
| zip_code | VARCHAR | Postal code of the crash location |
| latitude, longitude | DOUBLE | Coordinates of the crash location |
| location | VARCHAR | Latitude/longitude pair |
| on_street_name | VARCHAR | Street on which the crash occurred |
| cross_street_name | VARCHAR | Nearest cross street |
| off_street_name | VARCHAR | Street address if known |

cd /Users/yubo/Documents/Honda/poppy-sandbox/E004/nemotron-3-ultra-free/Q03 && python3 << 'EOF'
import duckdb
import pandas as pd

conn = duckdb.connect()
df = conn.execute("""
    SELECT 
        borough,
        COUNT(*) as total_crashes,
        SUM(number_of_persons_injured) as total_injured,
        SUM(number_of_persons_killed) as total_killed,
        SUM(number_of_pedestrians_injured) as ped_injured,
        SUM(number_of_pedestrians_killed) as ped_killed,
        SUM(number_of_cyclist_injured) as cyclist_injured,
        SUM(number_of_cyclist_killed) as cyclist_killed,
        SUM(number_of_motorist_injured) as motorist_injured,
        SUM(number_of_motorist_killed) as motorist_killed
    FROM read_parquet('./data/crashes.parquet')
    WHERE borough IS NOT NULL AND borough != ''
    GROUP BY borough
    ORDER BY total_crashes DESC
""").df()

print(df.to_string(index=False))
print("\n--- Per capita / rate considerations ---")
# Also show casualties per crash
df['casualties_per_crash'] = (df['total_injured'] + df['total_killed']) / df['total_crashes']
print(df[['borough', 'total_crashes', 'total_injured', 'total_killed', 'casualties_per_crash']].to_string(index=False))
EOF

import duckdb
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import os

# NYC borough populations (2023 estimates)
populations = {
    'BROOKLYN': 2590516,
    'QUEENS': 2405464,
    'MANHATTAN': 1694251,
    'BRONX': 1471160,
    'STATEN ISLAND': 495747
}

conn = duckdb.connect()
df = conn.execute("""
    SELECT 
        borough,
        COUNT(*) as total_crashes,
        SUM(number_of_persons_injured) as total_injured,
        SUM(number_of_persons_killed) as total_killed
    FROM read_parquet('./data/crashes.parquet')
    WHERE borough IS NOT NULL AND borough != ''
    GROUP BY borough
""").df()

df['population'] = df['borough'].map(populations)
df['crashes_per_100k'] = df['total_crashes'] / df['population'] * 100000
df['injuries_per_100k'] = df['total_injured'] / df['population'] * 100000
df['fatalities_per_100k'] = df['total_killed'] / df['population'] * 100000

print(df[['borough', 'total_crashes', 'crashes_per_100k', 'injuries_per_100k', 'fatalities_per_100k']].to_string(index=False))

# Create visualization
os.makedirs('./out', exist_ok=True)

fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 3, figsize=(15, 5))

# Total crashes
axes[0].bar(df['borough'], df['total_crashes'], color='steelblue')
axes[0].set_title('Total Crashes by Borough')
axes[0].set_ylabel('Number of Crashes')
axes[0].tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)

# Crashes per 100k
axes[1].bar(df['borough'], df['crashes_per_100k'], color='coral')
axes[1].set_title('Crashes per 100k Population')
axes[1].set_ylabel('Crashes per 100k')
axes[1].tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)

# Fatalities per 100k
axes[2].bar(df['borough'], df['fatalities_per_100k'], color='darkred')
axes[2].set_title('Fatalities per 100k Population')
axes[2].set_ylabel('Fatalities per 100k')
axes[2].tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)

plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('./out/borough_danger.png', dpi=150, bbox_inches='tight')
print("\nChart saved to ./out/borough_danger.png")
EOF
